_source: GitHub's own rendering of each Markdown body the footer tests use, recorded 2026-11-17/18 with POST https://api.github.com/markdown (mode=gfm), the renderer behind a pull request's body_html. `expected` is the footer a reader sees in GitHub's HTML, checked by hand against each test's own assertion when recorded. To add a case: render the body the same way and append it.
